create_BenchmarkClient: create a BenchmarkClient to send gRPC benchmark requests to a server with configurable security and payload
build_UnarySyncBenchmarkClient: build a UnarySyncBenchmarkClient to dispatch synchronous unary gRPC calls via a thread pool
build_UnaryAsyncBenchmarkClient: build a UnaryAsyncBenchmarkClient to dispatch asynchronous unary gRPC calls using future callbacks
build_StreamingSyncBenchmarkClient: build a StreamingSyncBenchmarkClient to send bidirectional streaming gRPC requests across multiple streams
build_ServerStreamingSyncBenchmarkClient: build a ServerStreamingSyncBenchmarkClient to send server streaming gRPC requests and measure per-response latency
